notes: zoho.com/careers renders one Zoho Recruit job widget (#rec_job_listing_div) with region (ul.zwc-region-list) and country (ul.zwc-contry-list) dropdowns plus keyword/location search boxes. The widget maps nine region hosts to GET /recruit/v2/public/Job_Openings?pagename=Careers&source=CareerSite&extra_fields=["Remote_Job","Job_Description"] (APAC hosts include careers.zohocorp.com). Those requests carry no search or filter values, so region/country/keyword filtering happens client-side over the loaded rows. A live APAC request returned 2 rows with Job_Type 'Full time' and only a Remote_Job facet; overall option values beyond the collected records are not published natively.
